text:
¿But how saber, without the mirada,

the hermosura of the forest, the grandeza of the sea?


The forest estaba tras of mí; lo conocían

mis oídos: the rumor of his hojas,

the confusión of the canto of his pájaros.

Sonidos that venían of a remoto lugar.

And the sea of the otro lado, golpeando

the frente, without rozarla,

cubriéndola of gotas. Was my piel

quien descubría his frescura,

my soñoliento olfato quien entraba in the pecho

his duro olor.

¿But how saber, without the mirada,

the hermosura of the forest, the grandeza of the sea?

Porque no there was more, in the lugar of the pecho,

that a extendida sombra.


(¿Mas what frío candente mis párpados abrasa,

what light me desvanece, what prolongado beso

llega hasta the mismo centro of the sombra?)


Joven the rostro was,

his labios sonreían,

and the retenido fire of his cuerpo

was quemada light.

Entramos in the sea, rompíamos

the sky with the frente,

and envueltos in the aguas contemplamos

the orillas of the forest,

his extensa fosquedad.

Miré, tendidos in the playa, the rostro:

contemplaba the nubes;

and the retenido fire of his cuerpo

was a sombrío resplandor.

Penetramos the forest, and in the lindes

detuvimos the pasos;

perdido, tras the troncos, miramos how the sea

oscurecía.

Tenía triste the rostro,

and antes that to siempre envejeciera

puse mis labios in the suyos.
